name: Green River (Upper) — Green River Lakes to Names Hill
gaugeName: Green River At Warren Bridge, Near Daniel, WY (USGS 09188500)
blurb: Green River (Upper): sections between Wyoming Game and Fish Department river access points.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Green River Lake (Green): approximate area only. Take-out Roaring Fork (Green): approximate agency-documented access area. Wyoming: next to private land the streambed is private — no anchoring, wading or getting out without landowner permission; floating through is legal. Watercraft entering Wyoming Mar 1–Nov 30 need an AIS inspection. Mileage: preliminary NHDPlus V2 routed geometry (5.4 mi); no agency mileage found.

notices.title: Remote upper Green River
notices.text: Wyoming Game and Fish advises experienced floaters for this upper reach and does not recommend large boats or drift boats. Low water can make it unfloatable. Check current conditions and road access before going.
